title: Day In A Life Of A Software Engineer #shorts
transcript: I'm Alex and I'm a software engineer I'm 20 and I'm actually an intern I'm in between my second and third year of electrical engineering I decided to take a break from uni because I just wanted to chill out a bit in life have some more time for myself and make some money I have the same old morning routine and I'm usually at my house by 8 45 I get to office at 9am and this is how it looks like I always have breakfast at the office and it's always always porridge I'm on a satellite comps project can't tell you exactly what I do but I do a lot of python and that's not so much writing it but actually much more reading and debugging I also did a fair amount of devops we used to get back for this and it works wonders so it's 12 and I always get lunch at this time lunch is free so that's all about the office every day and after work I always go to the gym every single day it's a big part of my life
